title: Completeness of the finite-projective model on the intrinsic small site
statement: For a scheme T, a Noetherian commutative ring A in the coefficient universe, an ideal I, and a complex P of finite projective A-modules, the termwise completed constant model on completedCechSite T is locally ringed-ideal complete for the first finite projection. No boundedness hypothesis is needed for this multiplication-difference criterion.

source.place: Proposition 6.6.11; Lemmas 6.5.8 and 6.6.8, with the recorded completed coefficient comparisons.

proof.text: Transfer exact countable products from every actual pro-etale slice through the small-site and slice equivalences. Apply the generic finite-projective retract criterion. Its coefficient-ring premise is the multiplication-difference calculation for the finite quotient tower: the scalar is nilpotent at each quotient. Each term of P is a retract of a finite free module, giving the other premise.

lean.statement:
theorem cech_model_complete (T : Scheme.{u})
    {A : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] (I : Ideal A)
    (P : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) ℤ)
    (hP : ∀ q : ℤ, Module.Finite A (P.X q) ∧ Module.Projective A (P.X q)) :
    ConstantCompletion.IsComplete
      (ConstantCompletion.projection (completedCechTopology T) A I 0)
      ((ConstantCompletion.Q _).obj (AdicPerfectModel.model (completedCechTopology T) I P))
